title: Shell command via os.system() — review required
description: os.system() runs a string through the system shell. Any attacker-influenced fragment becomes OS command injection; even static commands inherit shell quoting pitfalls. This lexical rule cannot prove taint — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Replace os.system() with subprocess.run([...]) using an argument list and shell=False (the default). Never concatenate input into a command string; resolve the executable by absolute path.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches every os.system( call including static safe commands. Other launchers (popen with shell=True, subprocess call with a string) are separate rules.
